ref.description: The verse or passage, such as 'Colossians 3:1' or 'Colossians 3:1-2'.

lang.description: english: the words are the verse's English, split from the translation's chunks. greek: the words are the verse's Greek. hebrew: the words are the pieces of the verse's Hebrew words.

words.description: The words to diagram, in order. `i` is the word's place in this list, 0 on: it is what the answer's `i` names. Every one appears in the diagram exactly once.

i.description: The word's place in `words`, counting from 0.

chunk.description: English only: the translation chunk the word is part of; the words of one chunk render the same Greek word or words. Counted within its verse.

lemma.description: Greek and Hebrew: the word's dictionary form (a Hebrew prefix has none).

parse.description: Greek: the Robinson-Pierpont parsing code, such as 'N-DSM' (noun, dative singular masculine) or 'V-PAM-2P'. Hebrew: the piece's part of the word's parsing, such as 'Prep-b', 'Art' or 'V-Qal-Perf-3ms'.

gloss.description: Hebrew only: the piece's English gloss, where it has one.

verse.description: Only when the request spans several verses: the number of the verse the word is in.

greek.description: English only: the verse's Greek words in Greek order (an Old Testament verse's Hebrew words in their order), as context for placing the English words by function. Each is part of the English chunk named.

text.description: The Greek word as the verse has it.

parse.description: Its Robinson-Pierpont parsing code (a Hebrew word's: its whole parsing, prefixes and suffix).

chunk.description: The English chunk that renders it, when the translation has one.

verse.description: Only when the request spans several verses: the number of the verse the word is in.

faults.description: Only on a second ask: what was wrong with the first answer, each in a line. Make the diagram again and put right every one.
